svg.title: Chef — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as chef, wearing a chef jacket and a chef hat. Visible work cue: A shallow rounded frying pan has a clearly extended handle beneath two separated steam curls. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a chef hat.
